name: Shirase Moka
source: A newcomer idol working at the same agency as [url=/c3225]Chikane[/url] who has been recently gaining popularity. Moka is a bit obsessed with Chikane and sometimes has delusions about her. She acts sweet in the public eye, but in reality is quite scheming.
